headword: {倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}

definitions.explanation: Playing back audio or video at a speed faster than normal, typically at twice the original speed. Used widely when watching lectures, podcasts, or recorded content to save time.

examples.japanese: {倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To watch a video at double speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{講義|こうぎ}→講義：01579_kougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{録画|ろくが}→録画：04441_rokuga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listened to the recorded lecture at double speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently young people these days watch even dramas at double speed.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{倍速|ばいそく}→倍速：25707_baisoku⟧ (double speed) + ⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧ (playback). This term has become very common in the streaming age, with the trend of watching content at accelerated speed becoming a cultural talking point in Japan. The practice is especially common among students and busy professionals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to watch at double speed
- {倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: double-speed playback function
- 1.5{倍速|ばいそく}{再生|さいせい}: 1.5x speed playback
- 2{倍速|ばいそく}{再生|さいせい}: 2x speed playback

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧: playback — normal-speed playback
- ⟦{早送|はやおく}り→早送り：05402_hayaokuri⟧: fast forward — skipping ahead through content
- {スロー再生|すろーさいせい}: slow-motion playback
